# K-mer spectrum

A k-mer is a run of k bases. This module counts every k-mer in your sequences and
shows the spectrum: how many distinct k-mers were seen once, twice and so on.

## Settings

- **K-mer length**: longer k-mers are more specific; short sequences rarely repeat them.

## Results

`results/kmers.tsv` lists every k-mer and how often it was seen.
